evidence: For adults with septic shock on vasopressors, we recommend an initial target mean arterial pressure (MAP) of 65 mm Hg over higher MAP targets
note: Initial resuscitation target for adults with septic shock on vasopressors; text gives target value 65 without an explicit comparison operator. Not a patient risk condition.

evidence: While some tissues, such as the brain and kidneys have the ability to auto-regulate blood flow, MAPs below a threshold, usually understood to be approximately 60 mm Hg, are associated with decreased organ perfusion, which tracks linearly with MAP [79].
note: Threshold described as approximately 60 mm Hg.

evidence: Previous SSC guidelines recommended targeting a MAP of greater than 65 mm Hg for initial resuscitation.
note: Historical target from previous SSC guidelines, superseded by Recommendation 9.
